description: Defines Swagger API documentation classes for FinancialActivityAccounts API endpoints in the Fineract project.

classes.name: FinancialActivityAccountsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes representing Swagger API response and request schemas for FinancialActivityAccounts endpoints.

classes.name: GetFinancialActivityAccountsResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response of getting financial activity accounts.

classes.name: PostFinancialActivityAccountsRequest
classes.description: Schema for the request to create a new financial activity account.

classes.name: PostFinancialActivityAccountsResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after creating a financial activity account.

classes.name: PutFinancialActivityAccountsRequest
classes.description: Schema for the request to update a financial activity account.

classes.name: PutFinancialActivityAccountsResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after updating a financial activity account.

classes.name: PutFinancialActivityAccountsResponse.PutFinancialActivityAccountscommentsSwagger
